item.title: Exercise pictures arrive with the cue
item.summary: When Murph teaches a movement in a scheduled Messages cue, it now includes a reviewed exercise picture when one is available and keeps internal catalog labels out of the conversation.
item.details: If a picture is missing and you ask to see it, Murph uses the reviewed catalog image when available and can create an instructional image when the catalog has none. Setup-only and non-instructional turns remain text-first.
